title: Acceptance evaluation cannot select a coordinator's concurrence or notice record as evidence; the holder must re-quote it
outcome: An authority-text item's evaluation can cite the legitimate (a) concurrence and (b) Greg-notice records written by coordinators, who are by nature non-holders, without the holder copying their proofs into a holder note. Alternatively, it is recorded that the quote-in-holder-note remedy is the intended permanent contract, and that is documented where evaluators and holders will find it.
acceptance: Either termal_evaluate_acceptance accepts a selected non-holder record when it is a coordinator concurrence or notice record on the same item, keeping every existing provenance check; or the decision to keep the quote-in-holder-note remedy is recorded, with its rationale, and documented in docs/ next to the evaluation endpoints.

If the behaviour changes, a test shows a coordinator concurrence record on the item being selected directly and accepted, while an arbitrary non-holder note is still refused with the existing remedy text.
No widening of who may evaluate or what counts as acceptance; the change only concerns how already-legitimate evidence is cited.
